description: Default for visualizing geometry: open a solid interactive 3D view in the Gradient Dynamics browser viewer for a generated geometry_surface or verified uploaded STL or STEP, including imported CAD surfaces. A static picture or 2D section alone does not replace this viewer unless explicitly requested. An upload needs no geometry job or second upload. A STEP, or a large ASCII STL, gets a bounded display derivative; keep source_artifact_id for inspection and meshing. Render Y-up with orbit/pan/zoom, fit, standard views, sections, measurements and PNG capture. Measurements use tessellation, not exact CAD. Open viewer_url in the browser, not an embedded chat panel; show one labelled browser link if opening is unavailable. Continue already requested meshing/mesh sections. No geometry regeneration. May return a pending operation_id instead of the finished result. Continue with get_operation at retry_after_seconds intervals; on success use result, then continue the requested workflow. Do not resubmit to check progress.
name: view_geometry
title: View geometry
